verdict.rationale: Lovable's own Slack and Telegram integrations let users ask questions about their workspace apps and run read-only queries against the project database. That gives a thin, conversational route to AI answers drawn from the user's own data. The AI connector only adds AI features to the user's built app (a building block), and custom MCP context serves building rather than insights, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: documented in-editor AI analysis of project or app data, proactive insights and suggestions derived from that data, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
